entries.reason: Workspace argument parsing raises a plain ValueError with no structured fields beyond its bounded caller-safe message; the exit code already classifies it as caller input.
ContractError is a developer compiler diagnostic whose complete contract is its single bounded validation message; it has no retry, stage, or upstream metadata to preserve.
The privacy registry loader combines plain JSON or filesystem exceptions with the exact registry path for a developer-only gate; none of the caught types carries actionable structured fields.
The domain-boundary maintainer gate returns the exact invalid-baseline parsing message; its caught filesystem, Unicode, and JSON exceptions expose no stable action fields beyond that diagnostic.

MCP startup has no established JSON-RPC connection on which to return an error envelope, and the fixed stderr line intentionally prevents arbitrary initialization exceptions or captured stdout from leaking into protocol output.
The quality profiler records an unexpected compiler-check exception as a developer gate failure; arbitrary exceptions provide no stable decision fields that the profiler can preserve.
Baseline validation returns a plain TypeError or ValueError diagnostic to the developer quality report; those exception classes expose no additional actionable protocol fields.
Base-baseline validation returns a plain TypeError or ValueError diagnostic to the developer quality report; those exception classes expose no additional actionable protocol fields.
The contract-expansion slope checker returns a developer remediation together with a plain Git, JSON, or filesystem exception; the caught types have no stable retry or stage fields.
Quality-baseline loading reports a plain local parsing exception to repository maintainers; the caught standard exceptions carry no structured consumer decision metadata.
Invalid quality-baseline content is represented only by a plain TypeError or ValueError plus a fixed maintainer command; no richer exception contract exists to retain.
Baseline-write failure is a developer-only local gate diagnostic over plain standard exceptions; no stage, retryability, or upstream contract is available below this boundary.

After Evidence is durably published, checkpoint cleanup failure is a warning rather than command failure; the fixed text already preserves the only decision fact and intentionally omits raw local OSError text.
